searchText: **ACDT <t:1762783200:R>** Agenda: <https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1797> Stream: <https://youtube.com/watch?v=uU4Vq7yeiGc> Zoom: <https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/88479308162?pwd=9XvtF4kjIfZ42rQrvySQLJPu9bLz7u.1> X Stream: https://x.com/i/broadcasts/1BRKjgEWApjGw https://forkcast.org/calls/acdt/061 seeing discrepencies between the Glamsterdam Meta EIP: https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7773 and what is available for planning on forkcast. for example, the falcon precompile is on forkcast, but not the meta eip. i'm assuming the meta eip is authoritative. i didn’t see it PFI’d in time can go check and in the other direction, the meta has EIP-6873 but forkcast does not 6873 was withdrawn, but that wasn't reflected in 7773. same with 7667. i can PR to remove those from 7773 right now. ~~i think the precompiles will have to be an ACD conversation~~ [PR for precompiles](<https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10660/files>) just hasn't been merged yet, but was proposed in time PR'd: <https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/10767> even though they apparently weren't PFI'd in time? looks like they were - https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/1437518731298209903/1437521927538475131 so forkcast is correct. 7773 does not yet reflect all changes it might take a bit to get the CFI / DFI where is the discussion thread for eip-
